inputs.text: [excited] MIN… mee. [curious] This name isn't Greek or Latin like the others — it's the name of a place in Australia.
[happily] Minmi Crossing, [pauses] where its bones were found. [calm] It lived in Queensland, a hundred twenty million years ago.
[confident] Tiny — and for a long time, [pauses] it even held the record for the shortest dinosaur name in the world.
